sgt — semantic operation-ideal version control (kernel)

  sgt init [path] [--horizon <ref>]   bind git + the kernel op store; mine existing
                              history, or (with --horizon) only from that commit on (R10)
  sgt revert [--emit] <ref>   remove an op and everything built on it (I \ upset X)
  sgt revert <ref> --keep-dependents [--repair]   same, but drafts a continuation hollow
                              per dependent (--repair hands it straight to the LLM repair loop)
  sgt revert --session <name> [--emit]   revert every op a session's attribution covers
  sgt restore [--emit] <ref>  re-add an op and its prerequisites (I ∪ downset X)
  sgt after <a> <b> [--retract]   declare (or retract) the order edge a ≤ b
  sgt fsck [--json]           verify the op store's content-address integrity
  sgt log [--json]            the mined operation DAG
  sgt state [--json]          the current ref's ideal: frontier, coverage, oracle verdict
  sgt diff [--json] <a> <b>   semantic diff between two refs' ideals, grouped by symbol
  sgt oracle run [--tier N]   run configured build/test tiers against the current ideal
  sgt oracle override ...     record a human verdict (--status pass|fail --reason "...")
  sgt merge-op <a> <b>        draft a hollow reconciling a chain fork (AE2's refusal)
  sgt split-op <op-id>        draft an intermediate cut of a two-concern op
  sgt transplant <op>... --onto <ref>   draft hollows backported onto another chain (AE3)
  sgt identity split|join <a> <b>       correct the matcher itself, not a chain
  sgt fulfill <draft-id> --from-tree     supply a drafted hollow's image; stages, no commit
  sgt repair <draft-id> [--backend api]   fulfill an already-drafted hollow via the LLM
                              repair loop, then land it through the same oracle gate
  sgt commit [--message ...] [--override pass|fail --reason "..."]   commit what's staged
  sgt land <branch> [--json]  advance a shared branch record by CAS, gated oracle-green (LAW-G)
  sgt unstage                 abandon the staged candidate; restore the committed ideal
  sgt switch <branch>         materialize a branch's ideal (the sgt-native `git switch`)
  sgt save [-m "<msg>"]       mine the working tree + commit a witness for it
  sgt undo                    invert the last ideal edit (revert/restore/save/…)
  sgt map [--json]            (re)build + print the hierarchical feature tree
  sgt blame [--json] <file>   per-symbol feature attribution for a file's live entities
  sgt status [--json]        files/symbols/features, coverage, oracle status, drift
  sgt select <feature>...    explain the closure a feature selection induces (files, ops,
                              and the requires-chain that pulled in anything cross-feature)
  sgt why <op> [--for <feature>]   explain one op's feature attribution, or the chain
                              that pulled it into a given feature's closure
  sgt merge <survivor> <absorbed>        union two features under the survivor id
  sgt split <feature> [--apply]          preview (then confirm) a two-way feature split
  sgt rename <feature> "<label>"         override a feature's label, durably
  sgt move <op>... --to <feature>        retag ops (+ their symbols) onto another feature
  sgt revert <feature>        revert an entire feature's op-set (grouped ∪ upset X)
  sgt history [--json]        mined commits in order + every op's kind/feature/commit-index
  sgt preview <verb> <args>   side-effect-free preview of merge/split/rename/move/revert
  sgt compose [--json]        one aggregate read: map/history/status/forks/plan/drift/
                              sessions/trust + the oracle verdict + open proposals
  sgt fold --at <spec> [--json]   side-effect-free code(I) + oracle verdict at an arbitrary
                              frontier (a commit-index, `op:<id>,...`, or a ref); no checkout
  sgt plan intake "<text>"    decompose a plan into predicted hollow ops (off-chain)
  sgt plan abandon <session>  drop a session's pending hollows and its record
  sgt plan status [--json]    active sessions and their steps' match status
  sgt checkpoint [--json]     preview step<->op footprint-overlap groups, and drift
  sgt checkpoint --confirm-hollow <id>... --confirm-op <id>...   apply one named group
  sgt drift [--json]          ops mined that no active plan predicted
  sgt sync [remote] [branch]  fetch + merge a teammate's work; union ops, reconcile
                              pins/declared-edges/tree, surface any chain fork
  sgt push [remote] [branch]  non-forcing git push; a rejection routes you to `sgt sync`
  sgt forks [<symbol>] [--json]   list open same-symbol forks + their `sgt merge-op`
                              remedies; given a symbol, show that fork's two tips' files
  sgt propose create [--base REF] [--title "..."]   a base+Δ review object over REF (default main)
  sgt propose status <id>     staleness by re-union: current / clean-reunion / fork
  sgt propose land <id> [--subset <feature>...]   advance the base by CAS, all Δ or named features
  sgt propose render <id> --github   emit a suggested branch + a GitHub PR body (plain markdown)
  sgt propose publish <id> [--remote origin]   push the rendered branch + create/update a GitHub PR
  sgt tiers [--json]          the three-tier file boundary's effective config + coverage
  sgt tiers set <pattern> <entity|opaque|ignored>   add an override (`.sgt/tiers.json`)
  sgt session start <name> [--base <branch>]   a git-worktree scratch tree on its own branch
  sgt session status [<name>] [--watch]   active sessions + early-fork footprint overlaps
  sgt session land <name>     CAS-land the session's ops onto its target branch (U23)
  sgt session gc [--force]    reap sessions whose owning process has died
  sgt review-queue list [--json]   ops with session/agent/drift provenance, not yet reviewed
  sgt review-queue ack <op-id>... [--session <name>] [--note "..."]   mark an op-set reviewed
  sgt git <args...>           pass through to real git (refuses tree-mutating verbs; --force overrides)
  sgt mcp [path]              run the MCP stdio server for coding-agent clients
  <ref> is an op-id, an op-id prefix, a `file::name` symbol (its frontier tip), or a
  feature id/label (`revert` only)
  (read verbs take --json for the machine-readable sgt.api projection)

  sgt migrate [feature-ids|ops-v3] [--apply]   dry-run-by-default op-store schema
